reviews.comment: Professor Buenger's lectures are very interesting and easy to stay engaged in. The modules are based on readings that she gives you in class, so it's easy to find that information and the tests are all free response, but she's a fair grader. Definitely enjoyed this class and would take her again.

MGMT 466 is a capstone course at Mays, but it ranks among the worst classes I have taken. Dr. Buenger expects you to read her mind, so pay attention. Class "discussions" look like the class guessing at the answer until she supplies the right one. I wish she would just lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Buenger is a wonderful person with an inspiring story. However, her class is dull and you will spend long periods of time discussing things that fall under the category of common sense. I took several classes online using zoom, and her lectures felt the longest of any of them. Her exams are very fair and the homework is not overwhelming.

Take Pace if you care about your GPA. Too much work as a graduating senior (multiple papers, 3 exams, presentation, homework). EXTREMELY hard to get an "A" (seldom gave out >95, VERY easy to get a B though). Written response tests & final. I have to give her some credit, the class material is interesting. Overall, still better than MKTG 321.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader
